headline: Indian Markets Reopen After Holiday; Nifty Eyes 24,800 Support Amid Weak Global Cues and Corporate Earnings

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Indian stock markets reopen today after being closed for the Diwali-Balipratipada holiday.
Technical analysts identify Nifty support at 24,800, suggesting a buy-on-dips strategy.
US markets closed lower as hot inflation data and Fed comments increased interest rate concerns.
India VIX has risen significantly, gaining 18% in the last three weeks, indicating higher volatility.
whatHappening: Siemens has announced its Q2 FY27 financial results.
Major Indian stocks including Bajaj Finance and Tata Motors are in focus for today's trade.
Nvidia shares plunged over 6% following a probe into the CEO, affecting global semiconductor sentiment.
Anthropic is planning a $90 billion IPO, targeting a valuation of $1.4 trillion.
summary: Indian indices reopen today following the Diwali break, with the Nifty 50 looking to maintain support at the 24,800 level. Global sentiment is weighed down by US inflation concerns and a sharp correction in Nvidia's market value. Domestic focus remains on corporate earnings and a list of stocks to watch including Tata Motors and Siemens.
